name: Ranolazine
indications_original:
Ranolazine extended-release tablets is indicated for the treatment of chronic angina.
                  Ranolazine extended-release tablets may be used with beta-blockers, nitrates, calcium channel blockers, anti-platelet therapy, lipid lowering therapy, ACE inhibitors, and angiotensin receptor blockers.
contraindications_original: 500 mg twice daily and increase to 1000 mg twice daily, based on clinical symptoms. ( 2.1 )
warningsAndPrecautions_original:
Ranolazine extended-release tablets is supplied as film coated, oval shaped, extended-release tablets in the following strengths
                  
                     500 mg tablets are beige colored, oval shaped, film coated tablets debossed with “V” on one side and “08” on the other side.
                     1000 mg tablets are pale yellow colored, oval shaped, film coated tablets debossed with “V” on one side and “09” on the other side.
